title.full: Updating your mobile number or email in Singpass

summary.text: Log in to the Singpass website, then Menu and Update profile. A one-time password goes to your new number or email.

details.heading: Singpass Helpdesk hours
details.body: 8am to 8pm on Mondays to Fridays, and 8am to 2pm on Saturdays. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.

steps.name: Have your new phone or email ready
steps.text: A one-time password (OTP) will be sent to your new mobile number or email address to check it.

steps.name: Log in to Singpass
steps.text: Log in to the Singpass website.

steps.name: Go to Update profile
steps.text: Select ‘Menu’, then ‘Update profile’. It is under the ‘My Account’ tab.

steps.name: Follow the instructions
steps.text: Follow the instructions on the website to update your mobile number or email address.

example_phrasings: I changed my handphone number but singpass never update
singpass OTP still going to my old number
how to change email in singpass

sources.page_title: My mobile number/email address is outdated. How can I update my records in Singpass?

quotes.text: To update your mobile number/email address with Singpass, please complete the following steps:
Select ‘Menu’ > ‘Update profile’ (under the ‘My Account’ tab) and follow the instructions on the website to complete the updating of your mobile number/email address
Please ensure that you have access to your mobile phone/email as a One-Time Password (OTP) will be sent to your updated mobile number/email address for verification.
The operating hours are from 8am to 8pm (Mondays to Fridays) and from 8am to 2pm (Saturdays) excluding Sundays and public holidays.
If you require further assistance, please contact the Singpass Helpdesk directly.
